summary: When reaching the other side of a nether portal the animation plays forever until stepped out of
description:
## Info for snapshot video creators

Here are two gifs which can be used to compare the two versions of the nether portal exit animation:

 - Correct animation, used up until 1.2.5 (broke in 1.3.1 snapshot 12w18a) and is now used again as of 1.20-pre1: https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/399390463930400778/1097153888597069844/1point2point5-netherportal-anim.gif

 - Incorrect animation, used from 12w34a to 23w18a and now fixed as of 1.20-pre1: https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/399390463930400778/1097156653687787692/1point19point4-netherportal-anim.gif

Note that the "Entering the Nether" message being absent in modern versions is a separate bug and is not yet fixed (
 
 
 
 MC-12789
 
 Reopened
 
). The absence of inner faces in nether portal blocks is also a completely separate issue (
 
 
 
 MC-262512
 
 Resolved
 
).

## The bug

When you reach the other side of a nether portal the animation plays forever until you step out of it, even in creative. The animation is completely unnecessary here.

This bug first appeared in 1.4 snapshot 12w34a - versions 12w32a and earlier are completely unaffected (but many are affected by 
 
 
 
 MC-217613
 
 Resolved
 
).

I'd recommend fixing this and 
 
 
 
 MC-217613
 
 Resolved
 
 at the same time. A table explaining the expected behaviour can be found here: https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Java_Edition_1.3.1/List_of_broken_features#Nether_portal_exit_animation

Refer to Ismael Rosillo's code analysis below for how these issues can be fixed (and why 
 
 
 
 MC-217613
 
 Resolved
 
 cannot be considered a duplicate of this issue).

## How to reproduce

 - Build a nether portal

 - Enter it

 - Stay in the exit portal

 - The animation will start playing when it shouldn't
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft snapshot 12w34a.
2. Create a Creative world with default settings.
3. Build a Nether portal.
4. Enter the portal and wait until you arrive on the other side.
5. Remain in the exit portal without stepping out.
6. Wait at least a few minutes.
7. Observe that the Nether portal animation continues playing while you remain in the exit portal.
8. Step out of the exit portal.
9. Observe that the animation stops only after leaving the portal.
Observed Behavior:
## Actual behavior

After the player is teleported to the destination dimension, the Nether portal animation continues to play as long as the player remains inside the destination portal. It does not end automatically after the teleportation has completed and only stops when the player moves out of the portal.

This also occurs in Creative mode. The player can remain stationary in the exit portal indefinitely while the animation continues.
Expected Behavior: Upon reaching the other side of a Nether portal, the exit transition should complete without starting the Nether portal animation. Remaining in the destination portal, including in Creative mode, should not cause the animation to play continuously or require the player to step outside the portal to stop it.
